chunks.sourceText: The paper frames memory as a stability-plasticity tradeoff. A system must learn new episodes quickly without catastrophically overwriting older structured knowledge.

blocks.text: The paper frames memory as a stability-plasticity tradeoff. A system must learn new episodes quickly without catastrophically overwriting older structured knowledge.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这一段提出核心计算问题：系统既要快速记住新事件，又不能因为新事件破坏已经形成的知识结构。公式是阅读器用来表达快速联想更新的简化形式，不等同于论文的完整模型。
chunks.zhTranslation: 这篇论文把记忆问题表述为稳定性与可塑性的权衡。一个系统必须能够快速学习新的情节，同时不能灾难性地覆盖旧的结构化知识。

chunks.sourceText: The complementary learning systems account assigns rapid, sparse episode encoding to the hippocampal formation and gradual structure extraction to neocortical networks.

blocks.text: The complementary learning systems account assigns rapid, sparse episode encoding to the hippocampal formation and gradual structure extraction to neocortical networks.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这是 CLS 的中心主张：海马更适合快速记录具体 episode，新皮层更适合慢慢抽取统计结构。对 AI agent 来说，这对应 episodic memory 与长期 semantic/world knowledge 的分工。
chunks.zhTranslation: 互补学习系统理论认为，海马结构负责快速、稀疏的情节编码，新皮层网络负责逐渐抽取更稳定的统计结构。

chunks.sourceText: The theory links sparse hippocampal coding with reduced interference. Distinct episodes can be stored separately, then replay or interleaved learning can support slower cortical consolidation.

blocks.text: The theory links sparse hippocampal coding with reduced interference. Distinct episodes can be stored separately, then replay or interleaved learning can support slower cortical consolidation.

blocks.caption: Interleaved consolidation sketch
blocks.code:
for episode in sample_replay(buffer):
    cortex.update(episode, learning_rate='slow')

chunks.zhExplanation: 这里解释为什么需要两个学习系统：稀疏 episode index 降低相互干扰，而 replay 或交错学习让慢系统逐渐吸收结构。代码块只是把这个思想映射成 agent memory 的工程伪代码。
chunks.zhTranslation: 该理论把稀疏的海马编码和干扰降低联系起来。不同情节可以分开保存，之后再通过重放或交错学习支持较慢的新皮层巩固。

chunks.sourceText: For artificial agents, the CLS idea suggests that raw experience logs and distilled long-term knowledge should not be collapsed into one undifferentiated memory store.

blocks.text: For artificial agents, the CLS idea suggests that raw experience logs and distilled long-term knowledge should not be collapsed into one undifferentiated memory store.

chunks.zhExplanation: 这一段是本项目的桥接点。助手的综合判断是：CLS 不直接等于某个 AI 架构，但它提供一个设计原则，即 episode 存储、重放、抽象知识和当前工作上下文应有不同角色。
chunks.zhTranslation: 对于人工智能体，CLS 的启发是原始经验日志和提炼后的长期知识不应该被压成一个没有区分的记忆库。
